name: ceph-conventions
description: The ceph-conventions canon skill for how a contribution reaches ceph/ceph and tracker.ceph.com the house way, layered on github-conventions and code-conventions: the upstream PR workflow — the verbatim Ceph checklist, the Fixes trailer to a tracker URL, DCO sign-off; the ceph CI mechanics — the config-diff check cleared by /config check ok, the Jenkins ceph-pr-pipeline; stable-branch backports with their Redmine Backport issues and the Backport Audit; filing on tracker.ceph.com through the Redmine REST API after a running-system reproduction; and the security@ceph.io embargoed disclosure path
